recipes.name: EBIT and EBITDA, normalised
recipes.scope: Tier A/B candidates and Aramco; consolidated group

definition.numerator: Operating profit before finance costs and income taxes, excluding impairments and impairment reversals, with downstream inventory at replacement cost; EBITDA adds depreciation, depletion and amortisation; leases aligned to the IFRS 16 presentation

inputs.role: reported operating profit / income before finance costs and tax
impairment losses recognised in operating profit
inventory holding gain (+) or loss (-) disclosed by IFRS/FIFO reporters (CCS/RC adjustment)
LIFO layer liquidation effect (US GAAP LIFO reporters)
depreciation, depletion and amortisation including right-of-use depreciation
interest-equivalent portion of ASC 842 operating lease cost (US GAAP), only if disclosed

ordered_steps: Start from reported operating profit.
Add back impairment losses; subtract impairment reversals (IFRS).
Inventory: IFRS/FIFO reporters subtract the disclosed holding gain; US GAAP LIFO reporters subtract any LIFO liquidation gain; FIFO without disclosure fails.
EBIT lease alignment (US GAAP): add back the interest-equivalent component of operating lease cost; if not disclosed, EBIT fails.
EBITDA: add DD&A (IFRS includes right-of-use depreciation); US GAAP adds DD&A plus the full ASC 842 operating lease cost.
Exploration: full-cost reporters fail; successful-efforts and IFRS 6 policies are recorded as metadata.
Royalties classified as income tax fail; royalty cost inside operating costs is kept.
Company 'adjusted' measures are not used (see M04).
Convert at the period-average rate.
recipes.ifrs_vs_us_gaap: IAS 36 permits impairment reversal, US GAAP does not; IAS 2 prohibits LIFO; IFRS 16 single lessee model vs ASC 842 operating lease cost in operating expenses; IFRS 6 policy continuity vs successful efforts / full cost (Reg S-X 4-10).

handling.missing_values: Required item for the selected case missing -> NOT_COMPARABLE; a disclosed zero is a value, an absent line is missing.
handling.definition_conflict: Operating profit definition including finance income must be recorded; inconsistent definition -> NOT_COMPARABLE.

failure_conditions.reason: Full-cost capitalisation not reconcilable to successful efforts without well-level data.
Exploration accounting method must be recorded.
Royalty classified as income tax distorts EBIT.
Operating profit definition must be recorded.

recipes.name: Net debt and gearing

definition.numerator: Net debt = borrowings + all lease liabilities - cash and cash equivalents (other investments not deducted)
definition.denominator: Gearing denominator = net debt + total equity (including non-controlling interests)

ordered_steps: Read balances at period end.
Include all lease liabilities on both frameworks.
Deduct cash and cash equivalents only; issuer-specific netting of investments (e.g. Aramco 'certain investments') is not applied.
Hybrid instruments: classification must be recorded; unknown fails.
Convert balances at the closing rate.
Gearing = net debt / (net debt + total equity).
recipes.ifrs_vs_us_gaap: ASC 842 operating lease liabilities are on balance sheet but outside debt in issuer measures; included here for parity with IFRS 16.

handling.missing_values: Missing lease or cash line -> NOT_COMPARABLE.
handling.definition_conflict: Issuer gearing definitions recorded, not used.

failure_conditions.reason: Hybrid debt/equity classification must be recorded.
